scope: The app-used PreviewPlayback lifecycle, actual Geraldine adapter and native state engine, with injected audio, renderer and wall clock. Reads the existing native manifest without changing it.
cases: replay resets blink epoch at scene zero and reproduces poses
interruption immediately starts the native 400 ms return to ongoing emotion
paused recovery settles on wall time and resumes without a backward face timestamp
recovery inside one render bucket cannot freeze an opening cel
resume during recovery retains active speech beyond the 400 ms boundary
pause and paused interruption settle half-blinks and cannot revive speech
packet gap closes speech while retaining emotional intent
reset cancels pending play and retires stale sampler and expression traffic
audio suspension closes speech, retires sources and preserves clip position
scene end during the final return transition settles the face
scene end during an active reaction completes the return without audio
reduced motion suppresses idle blinks and keeps explicit native transitions and speech
limitations: Injected-clock checks do not prove browser timer precision, measured acoustic latency, perceptual lip sync or visual approval
Independent acceptance owns browser review and screenshots
The existing direction proposal for mandatory quiet-listening replacement is superseded by preserved emotional intent
